name: [🎵] Project : RUSHER
desc:
🎵 Update 0.2.10
- WANWAN SONG by 黒魔 
- 雪が降る by Project Skylate

Horizontal Rhythm Game(HSRG) that involves you destroying circles.
This game is currently in beta, so expect tons of bugs and changes

CONTROLS
This is a free-form rhythm game, ANY kind of inputs are treated as hits!
[what matters is how well your timing is]

🎵All music in this game are obtained properly by getting permission from artists

Inspired from TONS of rhythm games but notably : Unbeatable/Muse Dash (Layout), Rhythm Heaven/Rhythm Doctor/Phigros/NotITG (Gimmicks), Arcaea/Chunithm (Scoring System), DDR (Note quantization)
